lines.1: 「Whew. That bastard was asleep, so I buried a solid punch in his face.」
lines.4: 「I put it out with the garbage.」
lines.7: 「When I put it out, I had to camouflage it by placing ordinary magazines on top.」
lines.9: 「Is it really okay to throw away someone else's stuff without asking, Otome?」
lines.10: 「Are you suggesting it was a treasure?」
lines.12: 「Was it so precious that its disposal sends you into a rage?」
lines.17: 「It is proof you have too much idle time. Exercise.」
lines.18: Damn it. Otome just didn't understand.
lines.19: She didn't understand how starved boys our age could get.
lines.21: 「The adult magazines that really matter are hidden under a false bottom in my desk drawer anyway...」
lines.22: Even as a decoy, that was still a pretty big loss.
lines.23: But it was a book covered in Fukahire juice, so I supposed it couldn't be helped.
